direction_proposals.prompt: Create an original gameplay sprite for Sunken City, a 2D underwater exploration game. Art direction reference: Dave the Diver's grounded, humorous adult characters and readable detailed retro pixel sprites. Side-view adult salvage diver swimming to the right, full body. Natural stocky adult proportions around 4 heads tall including helmet: helmet occupies only about one quarter of total character height, substantial torso, clearly articulated arms and legs with proper full-length fins. Old brass diving helmet with a single round blue glass porthole and a small practical top lamp, worn muted burnt-orange canvas suit, compact yellow air tank, dark gloves and fins, simple harness and hose. Face mostly obscured by reflective dark glass, eyes only tiny subtle marks if visible. Calm capable worker with a slightly stout belly, endearing through silhouette and body language. Authentic crisp pixel art resembling an approximately 64x64 to 96x64 native game sprite enlarged with nearest neighbor: consistent small square pixels, economical clusters, restrained 4-5 shade palette per material, no smooth painting. Brass ochre, rust orange, dark navy, desaturated teal shading, subtle cool top light. Readable and modestly detailed, worn functional equipment. Avoid chibi, giant head, huge eyes, blush, smiling mascot face, baby proportions, candy colors, stickers, excessive steampunk ornament. One static horizontal swimming pose centered with ample padding on square genuinely transparent background. No scene, ground, shadow, text, frame, bubbles, particles or UI.

An original cute pixel-art salvage diver character for the game Sunken City. Distinctive design: softly rounded SQUARISH brass diving helmet like a little vintage underwater camera, with a wide horizontal rounded-rectangle blue glass viewport; through it a small simple youthful adult face with two tiny dot eyes, a tiny easy smile, NO beard, NO mustache, NO blush, NO huge glossy eyes. A small off-center practical lamp attached to the LEFT side of the helmet rather than on top. Compact pleasantly rounded body in muted burnt-orange overalls with teal-blue sleeves, charcoal gloves, short but clearly articulated legs and simple small teal flippers. A single pale cream air cylinder on the back and a little crossbody salvage satchel. Proportions about 3.2 heads tall, helmet about 30% height, rounded torso about 40% height: gently cartoonish, neither huge-head baby chibi nor huge-bellied middle-aged man. Friendly, adventurous, endearing through a light buoyant swimming pose and clean silhouette. Full body side view facing right, swimming at a gentle diagonal with one hand loosely reaching forward. TRUE chunky pixel sprite style, about 48x64 native pixel design enlarged with hard square pixels, limited palette, 2-3 flat tones per material, large clear pixel clusters, minimal details, simple soft silhouette, no texture noise or intricate machinery. Warm brass and orange balanced with teal, cream and charcoal. One character centered with roomy transparent padding, square image, real alpha transparency. No background, ground, text, frame, logos, shadows, bubbles or special effects. Entirely original independent character design.
